newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - General Mills estimate upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - General Mills estimate upped.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said Friday it raised its fiscal 1997 earnings estimate for General Mills to $3.12 per share from $3.07.

-- Dain Bosworth cited a higher-than-expected earnings per share figure of $1.00 in the fiscal second quarter for raising the estimate for the entire year. General Mills' second-quarter results beat Dain Bosworth's estimate of $0.96 per share.
-- Dain Bosworth said it will maintain its hold rating for General Mills stock, which is currently trading at 21 times the fiscal year earnings estimate of $3.12 per share.
-- General Mills makes cereal and other food products.
-- Its stock was down 5/8 Friday at 65.
